salawat_enabled.label: Salawat reminders
salawat_enabled.description: Include salawat upon the Prophet ﷺ in the rotation.

azkar_enabled.label: Azkar reminders
azkar_enabled.description: Include morning/evening azkar in the rotation.

notify_on_start.label: Greet on start
notify_on_start.description: Show time-aware azkar (morning/evening) when the shell starts.

quran_enabled.label: Quran verse reminders
quran_enabled.description: Every Nth reminder is a random Quran verse from api.alquran.cloud.

quran_every.label: Quran every N reminders
quran_every.description: How often a Quran verse appears in the rotation.

edition.label: Quran edition
edition.description: Edition id for verse text, e.g. ar.abdulbasitmurattal.

translation_edition.label: Translation edition
translation_edition.description: Extra edition appended to the verse, e.g. en.asad. Empty disables it.

morning_count.label: Morning azkar per reminder
morning_count.description: How many morning azkar (04:00-18:00) each notification shows.

evening_count.label: Evening azkar per reminder
evening_count.description: How many evening azkar (18:00-04:00) each notification shows.
